# WorkRed Studio

> WorkRed Studio is a premium web agency specializing in building fast, modern, and impactful digital experiences for businesses and startups.

## About
- Agency: WorkRed Studio
- Founders: Vedant Mahind (Founder) & Arham Chhajed (Co-Founder)
- Roles: Full-Stack Web Developers
- Location: India
- Website: https://workred.vercel.app
- Tagline: We build websites that convert.

## Services
- Landing Pages: High converting landing pages designed to maximize clicks, leads, and sales
- 5-Page Website: Fast, mobile friendly websites built to generate leads and grow your business
- Portfolio Website: Showcase your work with stunning animations and bespoke editorial layouts
- SaaS Website: Feature rich marketing sites with pricing tables, demos, and auth UI
- MVP Development: Turn your idea into a working product with scalable and clean architecture
- Website Redesign: Improve your existing website with better design, speed, and user experience
- Shopify Website: Custom Shopify themes with product setup, payments, and shipping config
- E-Commerce Website: Build custom stores with smooth checkout, inventory, and payment integration
- Error Solving & Bugs: Diagnose and fix codebase issues, performance problems, and dependency upgrades
- Maintenance & Support: Ongoing website updates, security patches, backups, and performance monitoring

## Projects
- InterJob (https://interjob.in): An India focused tutoring and freelance marketplace built to rethink commissions, payments, and access for businesses, students, and independent professionals in India. [Professional Work]
- Hospital Finder (https://hospitalfinderbyarham.vercel.app): A real world hospital finder built with Next.js and OpenStreetMap — fast, map driven, and designed for practical, city wide healthcare discovery. [Personal Project]
- Rishabh's Portfolio (https://rmaniac.vercel.app): A creative model portfolio bringing emotion, precision, and style to every frame. [Creative Model]
- InterMeet (https://intermeet-arham.vercel.app): Production ready, open source video conferencing platform built with Next.js, LiveKit, and Supabase. [Video Conferencing]
- Real Time Chat System (https://realtimechatbyarham.vercel.app/signup): Production ready messaging system with real architecture, real data models, and real time messaging. [Personal Project]
